decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is the firm's core business, and with no reported shortfall against aspirations and ample slack there is no trigger for problemistic search.

Dropping the comfort insole removed much of the overlap, so the supportive insole now fills a distinct niche in the foot-measurement and tailored-solution offer, though it remains the weakest-signalled product in the range.
The ergonomic series has its own page and fits the innovation direction, and two years is too short to judge it against aspirations, so the firm keeps its commitment.
Firefighter and rescue boots sit in a certification-driven market with long tender cycles, so slack lets management carry them while results build up.
As the home-page flagship, the moulded insole carries strong strategic commitment and benefits from resources freed by dropping the comfort insole.
